evidence.quote: The language of instruction is half German and half English.
Prospective students from non-EU countries submit their application to uni-assist (see application deadline).
Applicants who would like to apply for a Bachelor course as a part of the study program International Studies in Engineering (ISE) must first use the application portal of uni-assist.

notes: Teaching language: the programme is taught half in German and half in English; the DAAD page says the first year's basic subjects are taught in English, while the remaining four semesters are taught in German and English. Tuition: the UDE page states that the university does not charge tuition fees, but all students must pay a semester fee (Semesterbeitrag, ~320-350 EUR per semester), which is not tuition. Intakes: the pages state winter-semester application windows only ('For the winter semester: 1 May - 15 June' / 'International: 01.05. - 15.06.'); no year is given, so the sample JSON uses 2026 as a placeholder year based on the DAAD database edition '2026/2027' — the human auditor should confirm the actual year. Application channel: the pages state that non-EU applicants apply via uni-assist (not the UDE portal, and no separate VPD/preliminary review step is mentioned). Documents: the UDE page's enrolment attachment list is institution-wide for non-EU applicants; programme-level document requirements are not stated separately, so no translation requirement can be confirmed. The DAAD page names Goethe-Zertifikat B1 as an example of a German certificate; it is not an accepted test in the allowed list, so acceptedTests is left empty for German.

evidence.quote: Applicants must prove that they have studied mathematics in the last 3 years of the previous education entitling them to direct university access and have graduated with a grade of 2.5 (German grading system) or better.
German language skills B1 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: Goethe-Zertifikat: Goethe-Zertifikat B1

English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: TOEFL iBT Home Edition (since 2026): 4 Reading: 4 Listening: 4 Speaking: 4 Writing: 4 Cambridge English Qualifications: B2 First IELTS Academic: 5.5

note.fr: Un examen d'admission (Feststellungsprüfung) peut être exigé si aucun diplôme d'accès à l'université ne peut être prouvé.
note.en: An entrance examination may be required if no university entrance qualification can be proven.

evidence.quote: if no university entrance qualification can be proven, proof of the ability to study by means of a special examination after successful attendance of an educational institution abroad with a degree that entitles the holder to study there: passed entrance examination of the University of Duisburg-Essen

note.fr: Une note de 2,5 ou mieux en mathématiques (système allemand) est exigée ; les conversions de notes sont prises en compte.
note.en: A grade of 2.5 or better in mathematics (German grading system) is required; grade conversions are taken into account.

evidence.quote: if the applicant has taken mathematics in the last 3 years of the previous education, entitling him/her to direct university admission and has achieved a grade of 2.5 or better.
